title: doctor
description: Check what this machine's FFmpeg, drivers and GPU can decode, as `spherecut doctor --json` does: the FFmpeg build, the decoders and encoders it has, the VA-API and Vulkan devices, each format decoded in software, on VA-API and on Vulkan Video, and every problem found with the command that fixes it (on Fedora the fixes say "install" where a package may need swapping instead; `spherecut doctor` in a terminal gives the exact commands). Call it when a file decodes slowly or in software, or before a long job, to know what the machine can do. It reads no media file and starts no process.

render_node.description: The DRM render node to test VA-API on, such as "/dev/dri/renderD129". By default the one hardware decoding uses (/dev/dri/renderD128 unless the GPU names another).
